extraction_notes: Forward, reverse-leakage, and capacitance curves were digitized from the Ta = 25 degC traces on p. 2; curve points are approximate readings of the published plots, not interpolated vendor data.
The table also specifies reverse leakage maximum 25 nA at VR = 20 V; the structured reverse_current field records the separate 2.5 uA maximum at VR = 75 V.
VRRM is 100 V and IF(AV) is 150 mA at Ta = 25 degC; these ratings are not used as fitted curve points.
All tabulated values retain maximum-column semantics where the datasheet provides only a maximum.
